Definition: from G1937; a craver:--+ lust after.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, epithymētḗs means a craver. It occurs just once, in 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I take epithymētḗs as it stands — craver — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
